run_evaluation: run the action recognition evaluation script with a config file and model config file
run_training: run the training loop for action recognition with warmup classifier and main training phases
run_distributed_training: run distributed multi-GPU training for action recognition using torch multiprocessing spawn
run_dense_evaluation: run dense clip-level evaluation with 25 clips per video for metric stability
run_resume_training: resume training from the last checkpoint for action recognition model evaluation
